scope: Standalone retrospective diagnostic; frozen released scans remain unchanged
mass_spacing: Compare nested 1 and 0.5 MeV tested-mass grids; 0.25 MeV stress-region control if within budget. Histogram bins, fit windows and search endpoints are separate choices.
anchor_selection: Inherited stress examples and released local-peak masses; selected retrospectively before new simulations, not independent discovery targets
local_ordering: q0=max(0,r)^2; for positive observed r count r_toy>=r_obs; at nonpositive r observed tail is exactly 1. Nominal asymptotic display convention remains p0=0.5 for nonpositive r.
local_probability: Report k/N, add-one (k+1)/(N+1), two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson intervals, one-sided95 upper bounds at zero; maximum over two specified truths is only a finite-family conditional diagnostic
kernel_policy: Reuse fixed reviewed states and update sideband targets/count-dependent errors for each complete spectrum. Half-integer states use declared positive log-linear interpolation.
resource_policy: One BLAS thread per process, checkpointed computations; no large bootstrap or rare-tail campaign
historical_10pct: Actual saved histogram, parent fitting policy. Selection, luminosity and overlap equivalence remain unverified; scaled stress is a matched-shape diagnostic only.
claim_boundary: No validated new particle significance, coverage, or production scan release from a plug-in truth or finer grid alone

amendments.reason: Add released 2021 nominal-maximum mass78 for comparison with main upper-limit scan; before new mass78 simulations

holdout_normality: Split-half standardized KS p values descriptive only, not formal calibration because training moments are estimated.
